# Quantum ADS — tool catalog

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen_tool_catalog.py from the live connector registry. Do not edit by hand; tests/unit/test_tool_catalog_doc.py enforces it. -->

**139 tools across 22 groups** (Google Ads API v26). Every tool returns a structured dict; a missing backend yields `{error: BACKEND_NOT_CONFIGURED}` instead of raising. Write tools run a `validate_only` preview first (a failed validation never applies), then commit — in the same call with `QUANTUM_ADS_WRITE_MODE=auto`, or on a second call carrying the returned confirmation in `confirm` mode — and append a signed, hash-chained audit record. An optional policy file bounds what may be written. Writes are refused while `QUANTUM_ADS_READ_ONLY=true` (the default).

## core

| Tool | Plane | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `audit.anchor` | **write** (guarded) | Anchor the audit chain head in Bitcoin via OpenTimestamps (only its SHA-256 leaves). |
| `audit.anchor_status` | read | Upgrade pending OpenTimestamps proofs; report pending vs Bitcoin-confirmed anchors. |
| `audit.status` | read | Signed audit ledger: persistence, path, chain verification, public key. |
| `describe_tool` | read | Describe a registered tool by name. |
| `health` | read | Server + API version health. |
| `list_capabilities` | read | List connector capabilities and tools. |

## adh

| Tool | Plane | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `adh.customers.list` | read | List Ads Data Hub customers (accounts) the authenticated user can access. |
| `adh.jobs.get` | read | Poll a started ADH analysis-query run by operation name (status + result reference). |
| `adh.queries.list` | read | List the stored analysis queries owned by an ADH customer. |
| `adh.query.create` | **write** (guarded) | Create a stored ADH analysis query (guarded: validate_only preview + confirm token). Creates only; does not run the query. |
| `adh.query.start` | read | Start a stored ADH analysis query over a date range; returns an operation/job ref (async, privacy-checked run — poll adh.jobs.get for the result). |

## meridian
